No direct external parallels in Sanskrit, Chinese, or Tibetan are identified, and DharmaNexus records no cross-language matches meeting its threshold [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. However, DharmaNexus records substantial Pali-internal text reuse [DharmaNexus]. Most notably, it shares nearly its entire verse sequence (§0.2–9.1) with another eponymous Therāpadāna poem, *Udakapūjakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 334) [DharmaNexus]. It also shares extensive text (§0.3–7.3) across twenty-one matching segments with the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā* (Paṭhamo bhāgo) [DharmaNexus]. Further formulaic parallels in the Therāpadāna include shared passages with the *Phaladāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 129), *Citakapūjakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 118), and *Udakadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 499) [DharmaNexus].
